title: Meta’s New Muse Wonder Models: Can They Actually Automate Your Complex Tasks?
description:
Meta just dropped its 'Muse Wonder' models to take on the industry leaders, and we’re breaking down whether this is a genuine breakthrough for your automation tasks or just another expensive subscription.

What we covered:
• Meta Launches Muse Wonder AI Models to Challenge Industry Leaders
• Suki raises $90 million to expand its AI medical scribe and agentic workflows
• Meta says its new AI models are state-of-the-art for agentic tasks, memory and coding

Three distinct AI stories, with lively debate, useful discoveries and practical takeaways.

Listener question: Would you pay $200/month for an AI agent that reliably handles your multi-step work tasks?

What to watch tomorrow: not which AI headline was loudest, but which one quietly changed the rules.

Alex, Jamie and Rufus tell you what changed in AI, who wins, and what you do next.
